verdicts.item: D11 decision 1: engine wasmi only, behind a WasmEngine trait
verdicts.note: Gate first: real kernel (biquad + 1-sample feedback), 64-sample blocks, 16 voices, release; report us/block/voice and % of block at 48 kHz. Over the item-5 budget: stop and report, do not add wasmtime. CompilationMode::Eager, compile off the audio thread. No JIT because a plug-in cannot grant itself JIT permission on macOS.
SHA-256 hash + module id + version per blob, instances reference the hash; 2 MiB cap per blob; no host imports except kabl's ABI, no WASI; one-time Open/Cancel notice per content hash.

verdicts.item: D11 decision 3: one instance per voice
verdicts.note: Own linear memory; StoreLimits 4 MiB, over cap = crash; pre-built pool sized to max voices, rebuilt off-thread; never instantiate on the audio thread.
Trap, OOM or NaN/Inf output: fade to zero over ~5 ms then silence, warning badge plus toast; crash in any voice disables the module in all voices; stays off until reset or reload, no auto retry.

verdicts.item: D11 decision 5: time limit via fuel
verdicts.note: Calibrate fuel per us at startup and on device change; 25 % of block per module, 50 % for all custom modules together (scaled proportionally); out of fuel = silent block; 8 consecutive overruns = crash. [verify] fuel overhead on vs off.

verdicts.item: D11 decision 6: Faust optional, cut first
verdicts.note: One optional PR: a Faust effect compiled to WASM through a thin adapter, as a test of ABI generality.
v3 patch opened with v4: defaults plus a notice; keep the old state blob in the patch so reopening with v3 restores it; D12 may add migrate(old_version, state).

verdicts.item: D11 decision 8: ABI v0 is per block
verdicts.note: One call per block; buffers in module linear memory, kabl copies in/out; params in a shared array written by kabl, modulation and smoothing host-side; exports init, process, reset, optional state_save/state_load; D12 freezes it.

verdicts.item: D11 decision 9: nothing allocates on the audio thread
verdicts.note: Compile, instantiate, grow memory, load state all off-thread; memory.grow in process traps; debug assertion on allocation inside the audio callback.
[verify] decaying feedback loop into silence, flush-to-zero on vs off; if slow, DC offset or module-side fix documented for D12.

RAII guard at audio-callback entry/exit, standalone and CLAP: FTZ+DAZ (x86 MXCSR) / FZ (aarch64 FPCR) via inline asm, restore previous state on exit; not _mm_setcsr (deprecated, FP-env changes are UB in Rust). Before re-recording golden hashes render every golden patch FTZ off vs on and report max |diff| per patch, accept at -140 dBFS or lower, else stop. Test self-oscillating patches still start; remove per-module denormal workarounds only after that. Separate PR (agent 2).

Calibrate with the slowest fuel-per-us code mix so the fuel budget never exceeds the time cap; wall-clock backstop times each process() call and over the per-module cap counts as an overrun even with fuel left (8 in a row = crash); report calibration values on the dev machine and inside REAPER.

verdicts.item: D12 decision 1: no ABI freeze before 1.0
verdicts.note: ABI stays preview until 1.0; each revision only adds optional exports/meta keys, never changes or removes; v0 blobs stay loadable; breaking change escalated to Kosta; freeze is 1.0 release work.
kabl.meta text stays in the wasm; JSON only in the package manifest; creators edit neither by hand.

Host GPL-3.0-or-later plus a section 7 module exception in COPYRIGHT; SDK crate, macro, meta builder, template, package/manifest spec 0BSD; cargo kabl CLI with the test harness GPL-3.0-or-later; no kabl-module-test crate; manifest licence required, source required for copyleft; publishing a package permits redistribution inside songs.
.kablmod zip; same id and version with different hash refused with both hashes shown; same id from another author: first install wins; songs use their embedded copy.
Keep hash plus one-time Open/Cancel; reserve optional signature field in the manifest.
Rust supported; one-page C example (~60 lines) proves the ABI doc stands alone.
Module-exported migrate(old_version, state); trap falls back to defaults plus kept settings; downgrade starts at defaults and the song keeps the newer settings.
None in D12; reserve the manifest field.
FtzGuard (#128) covers wasm in the callback; docs only; the CLI offline harness must run under FtzGuard.
Validator renders 16 voices for voice-rate modules and states the run time.
sdk/ in this repo until after the first fresh-agent run passes.
Percent of block at 48 kHz/64, labelled estimate.
Publish 0.x at the beta under Kosta's own account; binary named cargo-kabl.
githubhandle.module; reserve kabl., demo., test.; the validator rejects them for third-party modules.
Opt-in bump arena in the SDK; SDK-only, no ABI change.
Not rejected; nothing is removed, so existing blobs and saved .kabl files stay loadable.
PRs 0-4 and 6 (about 2,800 lines); panels wait for 1.0; compatibility corpus starts in PR 0.
Different model, fresh context, docs and crate only, fixed task list, two runs with two modules; pass = both succeed, at most 3 doc defects each, all fixed.
Two clean Linux CI builds on the pinned toolchain byte-identical; no cross-OS promise.
Host ignores unknown keys; module declares abi_minor N and the host rejects N above its own minor; cargo kabl validator warns on unknown keys. PR 0 host, PR 2 validator.
Optional export layout_ext() returns the address of a length-prefixed table (count, then extension words); unaware hosts ignore it. PR 0.

Keep 0BSD; cargo kabl build writes the Rust toolchain MIT notice (core/compiler_builtins) into a kabl.notices custom section shown in module info; docs say notices handled automatically. PR 2 plus a host display item in PR 4.

Finalise CONTRIBUTING.md; add to COPYRIGHT that commits authored as Claude are output of the owner's AI-assisted sessions with rights held by the owner (Anthropic terms assign Outputs rights 'if any' to the user; no third party holds rights, so the module exception needs no one else's consent). Edits go in PR 0.

verdicts.item: D12 governing principle: nothing is set in stone until we ship
verdicts.note: Until kabl 1.0 ships the ABI, layout, meta format, package format and every other contract may change, including breaking changes (rebuild examples and saved test files, add a changelog line). Additive-only and escalate-to-Kosta apply from the 1.0 ship. Overrides D12 decisions 1 and D wording: v0 blobs may be rejected with a rebuild message before ship; the compatibility corpus is a regenerable regression check until the 1.0 freeze.
